data.notes_riya: wendy's is food and vince is apparell
data.notes_barbara:
Different industry; Different products; Different customer needs; Different business model

Vince sells apparel, while Wendy’s sells restaurant meals. The products and customer purchasing needs differ.
data.notes_matthew: Vince is a premium apparel brand doing about $300M. There is no food or restaurant angle at all.

data.reason: Wendy's sells fast-food hamburgers via a mostly franchised restaurant system. Vince designs and sells premium apparel, footwear and accessories through its own stores, online and wholesale. The products, industries and revenue models differ. Both sell to individual consumers, but that is the only link.
Different industry: Vince sells clothing and accessories to apparel shoppers; Wendy's serves restaurant food.

P2.6.text: At Wendy's, we're all about serving up fresh food, even if it means going the extra mile. When you walk through our doors, we do what we can to make everyone feel at home because our family extends through your community.

P2.3.text: Vince crafts understated luxury from California. Our design atelier was established in Los Angeles to capture the storied freedom and effortless allure of life on the coast. Lasting materials — rich, buttery leather, plush cashmere, incandescent silk and the softest wool — are rendered with exacting precision and nuanced details that make each piece feel personal.

P2.4.text: Quiet sophistication is found in our foundational heroes, which move through spaces, seasons, occasions, and phases of one’s life with ease. Spirited standouts are distinguished by texture, color, and pattern. Since our founding every addition to our women’s and men’s ready-to-wear, accessories and home collection is crafted to inspire a timeless confidence, allowing one to think more clearly and creatively — the truest luxury. This is Vince.
